title: Kecksburg craft was bell-shaped

tellings.quote: crash. I will say that the craft at Kexsburg in the movie was incorrectly portrayed as a flying saucer when in reality it was shaped like a bell or acorn.

plain: In 1965 something is said to have crashed near Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania. Jesse Michels says a recent film got it wrong by showing a flying saucer, because the object was really shaped like a bell or an acorn. Michels makes the point himself, without naming a source, to set the record of the crash straight as he understands it.
